tools.name: krita_server_info
tools.description: Discover tested capabilities, limits and session identity.
tools.notes: Example flags are fictional. Probe actual bindings and behavior; unsupported modules must not advertise successful tools.

tools.name: krita_project_load
tools.description: Validate and bind an immutable project profile.
tools.notes: Resolve profile paths under configured local roots. No network downloads or arbitrary validator commands. Existing documents keep their original profile binding.

tools.name: krita_document_list
tools.description: List accessible documents without switching the active document.

tools.name: krita_document_open
tools.description: Open a baseline and return an isolated working copy.
tools.notes: Opening cannot overwrite the source. Returned document ID/revision bind all later requests. Duplicate request IDs return the same handle.

tools.name: krita_document_create
tools.description: Create new artwork with explicit canvas and colour settings.
tools.notes: Reject unsupported colour depths/profile combinations. Do not inherit incidental foreground/background settings.

tools.name: krita_document_inspect
tools.description: Read document state, frame, layer tree, profile and protection policy.
tools.notes: Layer IDs are session/document scoped; return remappings after reopen. Server identity must never depend on layer names.

tools.name: krita_document_close
tools.description: Close a clean or explicitly checkpointed working document.
tools.notes: Refuse dirty documents by default. Discard requires a verified recoverable checkpoint. No close during an active edit.

tools.name: krita_resource_list
tools.description: Discover available brushes, profiles, palettes and blend modes.
tools.notes: Enumerate actual resources and hashes, not guessed preset names. Capabilities may differ per preset.

tools.name: krita_layer_create
tools.description: Create an editable paint/group/mask node at an explicit stack position.
tools.notes: Masks attach only to compatible nodes. Protected parent topology may forbid insertion. Native undo and server revision must record this change.

tools.name: krita_layer_update
tools.description: Set explicit layer properties without changing protected state.
tools.notes: Require at least one property. Validate advertised blend modes. Layer locks are not permission to weaken server protection; protected layers cannot be unlocked by this tool.

tools.name: krita_selection_set
tools.description: Create or combine an explicit document-space selection.
tools.notes: Mask is full-canvas linear 8-bit coverage, not colour-managed luminance. Feathering changes selection weights, never expands the separately enforced hard allowed-change mask.

tools.name: krita_capture
tools.description: Return a fresh lossless crop of a layer, composite or selection.
tools.notes: Require layer_id only for target=layer. Include native image content or readable resource; metadata alone is insufficient. Read revision mismatch returns STALE_REVISION, not a newer unlabelled capture.

tools.name: krita_sample
tools.description: Sample known pixel locations with explicit layer/composite scope.
tools.notes: Points address pixel cells; sample centers are (x+0.5,y+0.5). Expose actual native order/depth, never assume all Krita pixel buffers are RGBA.

tools.name: krita_checkpoint_create
tools.description: Snapshot content, metadata and recoverable native state.
tools.notes: Checkpoint creation does not change art/revision. Persist before claiming recoverable; report quota failure. Include layer tree, masks, frames, profile, selection and sidecars.

tools.name: krita_protection_set
tools.description: Bind or tighten preservation policy against a checkpoint.
tools.notes: Only initialize or tighten in MVP. Weakening requires a new explicitly authorized project policy/working copy. Protect appearance-affecting properties and ancestor operations as well as native pixels.

tools.name: krita_edit_begin
tools.description: Begin one bounded, guarded paint transaction.
tools.notes: One active edit per document. Capture rollback state before writing. Pin selection/brush context; never depend on the current UI layer. Only the allowed target/frame may change.

tools.name: krita_paint_stroke
tools.description: Paint one native brush stroke on the transaction target.
tools.notes: Require nondecreasing time. Unsupported settings fail preflight; never silently ignore tilt/flow/AA. Brush preset is immutable for the stroke. Repeated request_id cannot paint twice. Commit still checks the whole transaction.

tools.name: krita_edit_commit
tools.description: Verify and commit a paint batch or roll it back on invariant failure.
tools.notes: Barrier for native paint/projection completion, then exact protected-content checks. No success until verified. A failed invariant is isError=true with rollback evidence, never a successful receipt.

tools.name: krita_edit_rollback
tools.description: Restore the transaction baseline and verify the restoration.
tools.notes: Restoring old content increments revision; revisions never go backwards. If a human edited concurrently, preserve both states and return EXTERNAL_EDIT_CONFLICT instead of erasing human work.

tools.name: krita_history_step
tools.description: Undo or redo committed edits, or restore a named checkpoint.
tools.notes: No active transaction. checkpoint_id is required only for restore_checkpoint, which requires steps=1. Restore art/history without weakening protection policy or decrementing revision.

tools.name: krita_operation_get
tools.description: Read the status of a long-running operation.
tools.notes: The tool result completed means the status query completed; data.state is the operation state. Receipts are retained for a declared duration. Progress may be null/unknown in the implementation schema.

tools.name: krita_operation_cancel
tools.description: Request cancellation and report verified final state.
tools.notes: If cancellation is pending, return queued/running instead of this completed example. Do not claim cancellation until writes stop and restoration is checked. Export cancellation deletes only its incomplete temporary output.

tools.name: krita_registration_set
tools.description: Set export registration metadata without changing source pixels.
tools.notes: Mapping: export=(document-source_rect.origin)*scale+translation. Crop/clip and padding are explicit; reject inadvertent nontransparent clipping. Animation/frame references remain separately bound.

tools.name: krita_preview_render
tools.description: Render a project-defined game-size or comparison/composition recipe.
tools.notes: Recipe is validated project data, not code. Include actual per-axis mapping after rounding, fixed reference hashes, display-pixel assumptions and profile. Return unoverlaid render alongside overlays. UI recipes can use fixed pixel sizes instead of world units.

tools.name: krita_document_save
tools.description: Save a new layered revision and verify it by reopening a copy.
tools.notes: Atomic write to a new path. Refuse active/uncommitted edits. Verification must include layer tree, masks, frames, profiles and pixels; reopening verification must not replace the live document.

tools.name: krita_asset_export
tools.description: Export a registered transparent PNG and metadata from a pinned revision.
tools.notes: PNG MVP must support straight alpha; reject premultiplied requests until a tested project adapter explicitly supports and labels that convention. Never flatten the live source. Fail on profile mismatch/clipping; never auto-fix art.

tools.name: krita_validation_run
tools.description: Run registered validators against immutable revision/export snapshots.
tools.notes: Validation failure is data in checks, not a server execution failure. Execution errors use isError. Validators are separately registered local adapters, not arbitrary shell commands supplied by a tool caller.
